objective.outcome: Allow CLI users to set a positive per-request timeout while preserving all library defaults and retry behaviour.

current_behaviour: The CLI constructs SyncClient without an explicit timeout.
Invalid CLI arguments exit before a request.

expected_behaviour: --timeout accepts positive seconds and reaches the transport call.
Omitting --timeout preserves the existing library default.
failure_cases: Zero, negative, or non-numeric timeout values fail before client construction.

invariants.statement: SyncClient's public default timeout is unchanged.
Retry count and retry ownership are unchanged.

state_or_data_owners: SyncClient owns the transport timeout application

risks.condition: The explicit CLI option changes the default used by library callers.
risks.mitigation: Keep the default in SyncClient unchanged and pass the CLI value only when present.

verification_plan.claim: A positive CLI timeout reaches the transport call.
verification_plan.pass_condition: The transport receives the exact parsed timeout.

verification_plan.claim: Omitting the flag preserves existing library behaviour.
verification_plan.pass_condition: Existing client and retry tests pass and no default/retry code changes.

steps: Revert the bounded CLI and test changes.
abort_conditions: The change requires modifying the library default or retry owner.

current_scope: Modify the two allowed files and run local tests.
additional_approval_required: Publishing a package or changing the public SyncClient API.
